title: Shakira 01
name: shakira-01
arc:
A Shakira hip swing with straight arms out to the side at shoulder height. The weight travels from the character-right foot through centre (frame 4) to the character-left foot (frame 6) and back through centre to the character-right by frame 17.

The arms stay out and steady while the hips swing; that contrast is the move. Pingpong: frames 0 and 17 are grounded turnarounds.

frames.cue: Weight over the character-right foot, both feet down. legs straight. on the balls of both feet, heels lifted. character-left arm at chest height, elbow straight, out to the side. character-right arm at chest height, elbow slightly bent, out to the side. torso leans character-left. character-right hip raised. head forward.
